attributes.readMe:
## Parcel Dimensions (PD)

Captures what the packing station measures and derives what the carrier charges for.

Carriers bill the greater of actual weight and **volumetric weight** — a big light box takes the same van space as a small heavy one. The divisor that converts volume to weight differs per carrier (5000 and 6000 are both common), so this block does not pick one: `dimDivisor` is supplied by the consumer, and with none set the block reports actual weight rather than inventing a number.

`billableWeight` is the max of the two. `isVolumetric` is true when the carrier will bill more than the scale says — the one number here a packer can act on, by choosing a smaller box, which is why it is the only thing in the embedded view that gets a tint.

The edit view is the packing-station capture: four inputs and a live billable-weight readout.

### Examples

Two contained examples: a small hardware parcel that bills on actual weight, and a lampshade box that bills volumetric — the case the whole field exists for.

### Non-goals

Metric only. An imperial variant needs unit-aware serialization, not a display toggle, and would be a different field.
